quarterly_data.signal: First half (April 1 - September 30, 2025; semi-annual report): net sales JPY 863.6 billion (+4.3%), operating income JPY 24.7 billion (-12.8%), ordinary profit JPY 26.1 billion (-19.7%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 29.8 billion (-9.2%). Segments (sales / operating income): Information & Communication JPY 425.4 billion (+0.0%) / JPY 10.9 billion (+5.5%); Living & Industry JPY 330.5 billion (+19.9%) / JPY 14.8 billion (-5.4%); Electronics JPY 118.9 billion (-14.4%) / JPY 20.4 billion (-18.8%). Group R&D expense JPY 13,087 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 863.6 billion (+4.3%); operating income JPY 24.7 billion (-12.8%); Electronics sales JPY 118.9 billion (-14.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report, management's analysis): in semiconductors, photomasks were supported by firm demand for Asia, Europe and the US, and demand for FC-BGA high-density package substrates for consumer uses increased, but with a negative foreign-exchange effect the semiconductor business as a whole was flat year on year. Tekscend Photomask, which runs the photomask business, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market on October 16, 2025 and becomes an equity-method affiliate from the third quarter. Display sales fell after Giantplus Technology moved to an equity-method affiliate.
quarterly_data.figure: Tekscend Photomask listed October 16, 2025; equity-method affiliate from Q3
